lessons.trigger_condition: The adaptive UI report used category key 'grade' while the real tablet DOM used 'grading'. The browser therefore could not satisfy the full category allowlist and skipped adaptive ordering. Existing feature shortcuts inside each category also remained static even when verified surface deficits or non-directional market/release/event activity changed.
lessons.prevention_rule: Use the real DOM category key set as the canonical adaptive category contract, assign every existing shortcut a stable allowlisted data-feature-key, fail closed when DOM identities drift, and allow the V400 controller to reorder only those already-present shortcuts from verified attention signals. User override and exact original-order restoration remain mandatory.
validation_required: watched changes are exactly index.html, tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py, tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.css and tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.js
CATEGORY_ORDER exactly matches the eight data-category-key values in index.html including grading
all 18 existing feature shortcuts have unique stable data-feature-key identities
feature_orders and feature_allowlist contain the exact same keys per category
browser applies category and shortcut ordering only when both allowlist contracts validate
user can disable AI ordering and restore original category and shortcut order
UI runtime health treats adaptive category or feature identity drift as a critical failure
market/release/event activity is used only as a non-directional attention signal
no source code generation/rewrite, arbitrary commands, Git/main writes, or verification bypass is enabled
price, grade, stock, release and event facts are never invented
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V398 changes only declarative ordering of already-existing tablet DOM categories and feature shortcuts. It cannot create arbitrary UI elements, execute generated code, write Git/main, bypass verification, infer market direction, or fabricate TCG facts.
